units.source_text: 這位像是柔道或劍道選手的署長，他的審訊相當明快利索，

en.t: The police chief, who looked like a judo or kendo athlete, conducted his questioning with remarkable briskness and efficiency,

units.source_text: 與那位上了年紀的警察在深夜執拗的祕密好色審訊有著天壤之別。

en.t: and it was worlds apart from the old policeman's secret, lecherous, and persistent interrogation late at night.

units.source_text: 審訊結束後，署長一邊整理送往檢察局的檔案，一邊說道：「你可得好好愛惜自己的身體啊。

en.t: After the questioning ended, the chief straightened the files to be sent to the prosecutor's office and said, "You really must take better care of your health.
Are you still coughing up bloody sputum?"

units.source_text: 那天早晨我異常地咳嗽，每次咳嗽我都用手帕捂著嘴，

en.t: That morning I had been coughing strangely, and each time I coughed I covered my mouth with a handkerchief,

units.source_text: 手帕上就像落了一層紅色的霰雪。

en.t: so that the handkerchief looked as though a layer of red sleet had fallen on it.

units.source_text: 但那並不是從喉嚨咳出的血，

en.t: But it was not blood I had coughed up from my throat,

units.source_text: 而是昨晚我摳耳朵下面的小膿包時流出來的血。

en.t: it was blood that had flowed out the night before when I picked at a small boil below my ear.

units.source_text: 我忽然覺得，不言明真相或許對我更有利，

en.t: It suddenly occurred to me that it might be more useful not to explain the truth,

units.source_text: 於是，我低著頭一本正經地回答道：「是的。」

en.t: so I lowered my head and answered solemnly, "Yes."
